    goods = len(values[0])

    best_score = float('-inf')
    
    def backtrack(allocation, used_goods):

                allocation.append(current_goods)
                backtrack(allocation, used_goods + current_goods)
                allocation.pop()
    
    backtrack([], [])
    return best_allocation

    goods = len(values[0])

            current_allocation[i] = temp % 4
            temp //= 4
        
        # Calculate values for each person

        # Update best allocation if this one is better

            best_allocation = current_allocation.copy()
